mapper.select: SELECT platform_user_id FROM paiflow_identity_map WHERE source = #{source} AND old_uid = #{oldUid} AND status = 'mapped' AND deleted = 0
SELECT user_id AS userId, user_agreement AS userAgreement, agreed_at AS agreedAt, revision FROM paiflow_user_preference WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO paiflow_user_preference (user_id, user_agreement, agreed_at, revision, deleted, create_by, update_by, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, 1, UTC_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 0, #{actor}, #{actor}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(), UTC_TIMESTAMP()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE agreed_at = CASE WHEN user_agreement = 1 AND deleted = 0 THEN agreed_at ELSE UTC_TIMESTAMP() END, revision = CASE WHEN user_agreement = 1 AND deleted = 0 THEN revision ELSE revision + 1 END, user_agreement = 1, deleted = 0, update_by = #{actor}, update_time = UTC_TIMESTAMP()
